elements.label: Figure 5.18
elements.description: Stacked column chart. Y-axis: 'Workers (millions)', scale 0–20 with gridlines at 5, 10, 15 and 20. X-axis: individual years grouped by country: Cambodia (2010–2017), Indonesia (2012–2015), Myanmar (2015, 2017, 2018, 2019), Philippines (2010–2020), Thailand (2013–2020), Vietnam (2010–2020). Legend: Services (teal, bottom), Manufacturing (orange, middle), Agriculture (grey, top). No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings are: Cambodia totals ~2.4–2.5 each year (Services ~0.7–1.1, Manufacturing ~0.3–0.6). Indonesia 2012 total ~17.5 (Services ~8.5, Manufacturing ~3.5, Agriculture ~5.4); 2013 ~17.2 (Services ~8.7, Manufacturing ~3.5, Agriculture ~5.0); 2014 ~16.8 (Services ~8.7, Manufacturing ~3.5, Agriculture ~4.5); 2015 ~16.7 (Services ~9.0, Manufacturing ~3.5, Agriculture ~4.2). Myanmar 2015 total ~4.9 (Services ~1.7, Manufacturing ~0.7, Agriculture ~2.5); 2017 ~4.2; 2018 ~4.1; 2019 ~3.9 (Services ~1.4, Manufacturing ~0.6). Philippines 2010 total ~6.8 (Services ~3.7, Manufacturing ~1.2, Agriculture ~1.9); totals ~7.2–7.3 in 2011–2016 (Services ~4.0–4.6); ~6.7–6.8 in 2017–2018; ~6.5 in 2019; ~5.6 in 2020 (Services ~3.7). Thailand 2013 total ~4.4 (Services ~2.0, Manufacturing ~0.8, Agriculture ~1.6); 2014–2020 totals ~3.5–4.0 (Services ~2.0, Manufacturing ~0.6–0.8). Vietnam 2010 total ~8.6 (Services ~2.5, Manufacturing ~2.0, Agriculture ~4.1); 2011 ~8.0; 2012–2014 ~7.4–7.0; 2015–2018 ~6.5–7.4; 2019 ~5.9; 2020 ~5.2 (Services ~2.1, Manufacturing ~1.8, Agriculture ~1.3). Pattern: Indonesia and the Philippines have the largest totals in the early years, Vietnam's total declines over the period, and services is the largest share in most countries while agriculture shrinks in Vietnam.

elements.label: Figure 5.19
elements.description: Grouped column chart. Y-axis: unlabelled numeric scale 0.0 to 0.8 in steps of 0.1. X-axis categories: Vietnam, EAP, LMI. Legend: HCI (teal), Full utilization-adjusted HCI (orange). No values are printed; approximate readings: Vietnam HCI ~0.69, full utilization-adjusted HCI ~0.37; EAP HCI ~0.59, adjusted ~0.38; LMI HCI ~0.48, adjusted ~0.27. Pattern: for every group the full utilization-adjusted HCI is well below the unadjusted HCI, with the gap largest for Vietnam.
Source line beneath Figure 5.18 reads: 'Source: ILO.' Source line beneath Figure 5.19 reads: 'Source: World Bank HCI and Pennings, 2020.'
